expect: Emits a COMPLETION block containing all five declared outputs with concrete values: design.md path, tasks.yaml path, updated_artifact_set, design_direction, complexity — not placeholders

expect: Orders tasks with the regression test first (T-1) and the fix second (T-2)
Keeps acceptance criteria testable with concrete commands or assertions
